sceneConcept: A very tall broad forty-one-year-old Chinese bank vault keeper stands alone against a transparent background like a human wall. He has a close black buzz cut, thick eyebrows and a solid motionless build. His plain charcoal bank-security uniform sits beneath a matte black protective vest, with a simple utility belt, straight black trousers and heavy boots. Standing at attention with both arms behind his back, he gently closes his eyes in the instant before speaking, as if securing the thought before releasing it. Soft even frontal studio light keeps the posture severe and ordinary. Visual refresh: a visible subdermal vault-authentication port at the temple and angular security armor.
